lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traverse the primary torso mass. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming narrower and more irregular at the posterior transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the third vertical line from the posterior, located in the upper dorsal third of the torso. A second bifurcation/merging point is visible on the eighth line from the posterior at the mid-lateral point.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line is fragmented into three discrete circular blobs. The third line from the posterior is discontinuous, with a visible gap in the mid-flank region. The eleventh line terminates before reaching the lower ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch, situated ventral to the first two vertical lines. A secondary grouping of 2 spots is visible on the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-thigh align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line oriented at approximately 40 degrees from the vertical axis of the limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns are visible as short, straight conical buds projecting at a ~75-degree angle from the frontal bone; no lyrate curvature or spiraling is present at this developmental stage.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.75 times the pixel width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The distal 45% of the horn buds exhibit high-contrast white/ivory tipping relative to the dark proximal base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct white circular spots on the lower cheek area and a white transverse band across the bridge of the nose. A dark dorsal crest of elongated hair is visible from the neck to the tail base.
